en: Fixed non-interactive launches replacing a `~/.claude.json` that isn't valid JSON with defaults; the start now fails, says how to restore the file, and leaves it as is (anthropics/claude-code#87551)
zh: 修复了非交互式启动将无效 JSON 的 `~/.claude.json` 替换为默认值的问题；现在启动会失败，提示如何恢复该文件，并保持文件原样（anthropics/claude-code#87551）
